Claim 13 (Currently amended): A flexible respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the tube arrangement comprising: a flexible tube; a heater to heat the gas as it is delivered through the tube; a first connector provided to one end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a breathing mask; and a second connector provided to the other end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a CPAP device, said second connector including a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to said heater, wherein said contact elements are adapted to be engaged with a power supply provided on the CPAP device for supplying power to said heater, and wherein the flexible tube is made from a spirally reinforced plastic material.

Claim 14 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising an insulating sheathing body.

Claim 15 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the insulating sheathing body is removably attachable to the flexible tube.

Claim 17 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein said sheathing body includes a multi-layered design.

Claim 18 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the tube is a heatable respiratory gas tube.

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the heater is integrated into the tube.

Claim 24 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the flexible tube is made from a spirally reinforced plastic material.

Claim 25 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the heater is an electrical resistance heater.

Claim 26 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device.

Claim 27 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact element is provided within the second portion.

Claim 30 (Currently amended): A connector according to claim 29, wherein each contact element is provided within the second portion.

Claim 31 (Currently amended): A connector according to claim 29, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion.
